scope: clean-room product assistant control plane composed over existing Skeleton AI contracts
principles: deterministic control planes authorize model-proposed actions
fresh or private evidence dependencies are routed before synthesis
retrieved, tool and model content cannot self-promote into trusted control
external writes require explicit user action plus request-bound grants
assistant capability policy never owns a shadow tool executor or receipt store
write-class capabilities require the injected canonical runtime to have durable receipt storage
tool execution is bounded and idempotent
memory retrieval and durable persistence are separate decisions
automation cadence is bounded and represented explicitly
artifact creation routes by requested output kind
handoff and finalization preserve structured provenance without hidden reasoning traces

integration.assistant_tool_role: authorize and translate ToolProposal into canonical ToolExecutionRequest only
integration.write_durability_rule: reversible/external/security-sensitive writes fail closed without a durable canonical receipt store

explicit_exclusions: hidden chain-of-thought or private reasoning traces
provider SDK objects in canonical assistant contracts
promotion_rule: implementation candidate only; no completion or verification signoff is implied until exact-head CI and independent verification pass

validation.authority_invariant: ToolCoordinator requires injected AsyncToolRuntime and delegates admitted execution to self.tool_runtime.execute
